start: Help and feedback sheet open; microphone allowed; internet on

user_sees: 'Listening. Speak in Hindi or English, then tap Stop.'
A clock (0:01, 0:02…) and a level bar
'When you tap Stop, your recording goes through our server to an AI service in the USA that turns speech into text…'
must_not: Recording starting before the tap

steps.action: Talk for ten seconds in Hindi, tap 'Stop'
user_sees: The heard text in the box, on a new line under anything already typed
'Check the text. Fix anything, then tap Send.'
must_not: The text reaching MettleUp before Send
The clip left on the phone after it was sent
Earlier typed words replaced

steps.action: Fix a word and tap Send
user_sees: 'Thanks! We read every message.' or a Quick answer
must_not: The message recorded as typed (it must say voice)
The recording sent a second time

start: Profile → Settings → Help and feedback page (not the floating sheet)

user_sees: The same words and steps; the text lands in the page's box
must_not: A different privacy line from the floating sheet's

user_sees: 'Thanks! We read every message.' or a Quick answer
must_not: Two messages sent

user_sees: 'That was too short. Tap Speak and talk for a few seconds.'
must_not: The clip sent to the server
A day's recording used up

user_sees: 'MettleUp needs the microphone to hear you. Allow it in your phone Settings, or type instead.'
must_not: A crash
The phone's ask coming back on every tap

steps.action: Turn the internet off, talk, tap 'Stop'
user_sees: "Couldn't reach us. Check your internet and try again, or type."
must_not: Typed words wiped
The same clip sent again after a 45-second time-out

steps.action: Record after the day's recordings are used up
user_sees: The server's own words about the limit
must_not: Only "Couldn't turn your voice into text. Try again, or type." hiding the limit

start: Help and feedback sheet open with 'Back hurts on squats' typed

user_sees: Recording stops; the box still says 'Back hurts on squats'
must_not: Anything sent
The clip left on the phone

user_sees: The heard text added on a new line under the typed words
must_not: The typed words replaced

steps.action: Close the sheet without Send and open it again
user_sees: The unsent text still in the box
must_not: The text sent without Send

steps.action: Tap 'Speak', talk, tap 'Stop', then close the sheet without Send
user_sees: The text only in the box on this phone
must_not: The words reaching MettleUp without Send
The recording kept by MettleUp or the AI service
The microphone used at any time other than after 'Speak'
